description: Source code for visualizing and analyzing reference cycles involving CUDA tensors in PyTorch, including garbage collection hooks, graph creation, and HTML visualization.

classes.name: Node
classes.description: Represents a node in the object reference graph for visualization.

methods.name: observe_garbage
methods.description: Sets up garbage collection hooks and callback for visualization.

methods.name: annotated_references
methods.description: Returns a mapping of objects to their references for graph annotation.

methods.name: object_annotation
methods.description: Creates a short string description of an object for visualization.

methods.name: create_graph
methods.description: Builds a graph of objects and their references for visualization.

methods.name: to_dot
methods.description: Converts a graph of nodes into DOT format for visualization.

methods.name: to_html
methods.description: Generates an HTML page visualizing the object reference graph with interactive features.

methods.name: observe_tensor_cycles
methods.description: Sets up observation of CUDA tensor reference cycles and visualizes them.

methods.name: warn_tensor_cycles
methods.description: Installs a warning and visualization for reference cycles involving CUDA tensors.
